extracted.intended_audience: general readers and stakeholders interested in health policy, drug pricing, and pharmaceuticals (policy makers, journalists, patients)
extracted.subtask_description: A news article reporting on the pricing of the drug Daraprim and the broader market and policy factors that keep drug prices high. Intended to inform the public, policymakers, and other stakeholders about industry behavior, data findings, and policy implications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Medicaid payment calculation methodology (data note)
rubrics_metrics.description: To determine what Medicaid paid for Daraprim, Kaiser Health News used data made public by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. This figure represents a weighted average of Medicaid payments per prescription, across various strengths, package sizes, routes and labels. It does not include drug versions (represented by National Drug Codes) with fewer than 11 prescription fills per quarter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: KHN used CMS public data and computed a weighted average across formulations and package sizes; low-volume NDCs (<11 fills/quarter) were excluded. The reported average does not account for undisclosed proprietary rebates state Medicaid programs may receive.
